pbuf_qualified_tcp_attribution.scope: Exact observed cumulative prefix at PCM flush. Qualified TCP matches identify those calls only. A NULL return is not automatically one global heap fault; non-RAM/overflow/saturation and unmatched paths remain explicit. Later EOF/WebUI/peer-close samples are independent windows, never synthesized from this prefix.
